thread:
ashley: Noticing p95 jump on the east-coalesce pool during 09:12-09:20. Looks like microbursts where coalesce delay jitter increases from 3-7ms to 30-50ms.
ashley: Dumped a few traces, attaching stack snippet and queue metrics.
ashley: logs:
```
[09:12:14] coalesce_wait=42ms queue_len=6 tokens=120 kernel=A
[09:12:15] coalesce_wait=46ms queue_len=5 tokens=96 kernel=B
```
ashley: Thoughts? Could be gating incorrectly allowing large token-budget requests through the same micro-batch.
omar: Can you paste the token histogram for that minute?
ashley: token bins: 1-8: 60%, 9-32: 25%, 33-128: 15% (spikes of 256 seen)
jin: If big requests sneak into a batch with small ones, KV hit pattern changes and kernel choice toggles. Kernel switch cost + kv miss = tail.
perf-bot: perf snapshot 1759998900: p50=12ms p95=162ms p99=420ms cpu=67% gpu_util=78% kernel_switches=23
sophie: Quick mitigation: gate large requests to separate fast-path queue or apply per-req coalesce_timeout floor.
sanjay: We experimented with exponential jitter instead of uniform last month — better at smoothing bursts. Maybe combine with token-budget gating.
omar: Also consider token-weighted batching: define max_tokens/batch and preemptively flush when adding request would exceed.
ashley: Reproduced locally with a synthetic trace. Two ideas to try: 1) small 'burst bucket' that batches only <=32 tokens with tight delay, 2) large token arrivals forced to their own batch with max_wait=1ms.
jin: Agree. Also add metric: 'kernel_switch_rate' per batch to see correlation.
perf-bot: canary deploy prepared: coalesce_policy=v2-gated-bucket, jitter=exp(λ=0.04), token_gate=32
ashley: Deploying canary to eu-west-1 (10% traffic) now.
perf-bot: canary deployed @1759998920
omar: Baseline p95 before canary 162ms; will watch dashboards.
sophie: If canary reduces kernel switches and p95 drops, we need rollout plan and telemetry to auto-fallback.
ashley: timeline: 10m canary, 20m observation window, rollback if p95 > baseline +10% or kernel_switch_rate drops < -30%?
jin: Minor note: KV priming for hot prefixes may mask effect. Ensure KV cache cleared on test nodes or primed uniformly.
ashley: copying commands for canary knobs:
```
PUT /runtime/coalesce/config
{ "policy": "gated-bucket", "token_gate": 32, "jitter": "exponential", "jitter_param": 0.04 }
```
omar: :thumbsup:
sophie: If this helps, we should add a unit test in arrival_sim harness to cover mixed token distributions.
ashley: Will update PR with experiment results. Thanks all :rocket:
